items.title: ID Protection: Setup
items.note: Opens at the start of setup.
changes: Activating protection and Protection is activated are now one screen
New step: You're insured for $3M (copy still needs legal)
Data removal started: Now, Next and Later, with a note that it can take up to 3 months
Watching the dark web: what we scan for, each switched on
Monitor your SSN: SSN and address, then Enable SSN monitoring
Your trial ends: dates for today, the reminder and the plan start
Skip on the first two steps; every title is one line at the same height

items.title: Kitchen: Full experience
items.note: A signed-in member with the full experience.
changes: Chat-first Origin: Feed, Chat and Track instead of today's tabs
Voice chat on the shared demo, with a muted mic and a quicker "I'll look into that"
Set-up cards, a 30-day wrap-up and gentler tiles
Partner: invite sheet, pending state, whose-money menu and owner switch, with a Venn view
Credit monitoring gauge and household progress
Profile initials and header icons at feed size, consistent buttons
Nav shortcuts you can rearrange, emoji categories, receipt row

items.title: Kitchen: Onboarding
items.note: A new member, from sign-up to the feed.
changes: New-member flow from Sign up to the Feed (sign-in, card and bank are stand-ins)
Paywall without a back button, with billing terms and free credit monitoring
Welcome sheets you swipe through
Set-up cards and a 30-day wrap-up once you are in the Feed
Sign-up polish, credit monitoring and nav shortcuts

items.title: Product: Navigation
items.note: The new bottom navigation on today's Origin app.
changes: New frosted glass bottom bar: Home, Spend, Invest and Earn, with Ask anything as the last slot
Earn (the high-yield cash account) replaces Forecast in the nav
A pill slides to the tab you are on; the other tabs are quiet icons
The bar tucks into a circle when you scroll down and returns when you scroll up or tap it
Hold a tab to rearrange: the others jiggle and slide aside as you drag
Glass header: frosted menu and settings buttons, with a soft blur on scroll instead of a solid band
Home opens on Net worth; the stack of cards above it is gone
Net worth: 40px tabs with no dividers, Add account on its own row, Forecast sits by the balance
One selected style for toggles and date ranges: soft fill, no tray or border
Outlined buttons are soft fills, icon buttons lose their containers, and card AI buttons match Ask anything
Invest: the chart toggle moves into the filter sheet. Spend: chart and calendar become a menu

items.title: Earn: Cash Account
items.note: Opening flow and Cash page for the high-yield cash account.
changes: Cash Account opening flow, with glass headers
Cash page: a total balance panel with the APY chip and actions, and expected growth with a 3Y and 5Y toggle
Growth chart lines end at least halfway up, with a stronger green fill
Deposit from the Cash page once the account is open: bank, amount, review, sent
Starting date chosen from a calendar
SSN field keeps its dashes while hidden
Desktop overview rebuilt after Invest's Portfolio card, with Activity and Account facts in the side column

items.title: Product: AI bot navigation
items.note: The AI button opens a card of your agents, built on the new navigation.
changes: Builds on the Navigation prototype, with the same glass bottom bar
The AI button is its own glass circle beside the bar, with a dot when an agent has news
Tapping it opens a floating card of agent conversations above the nav, over a dark veil
The page's own agent comes first, then agents with news
Rows show the avatar, name, time, unread dot and latest message, and expand to show the whole message
An Ask pill with a mic sends your question to the right agent
The card springs open out of the AI button, like an iOS Control Center tile
Agent chats use Coin's header, buttons, input bar and bubbles
